page_title: TOU 2-4 BRE | Toulouse v Brest 30/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) took the corner.
90+4' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is replaced by Jaydee Canvot.
90+4' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Warren Kamanzi comes onto the pitch so that Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) can be given a rest.
90+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' 2 - 4 Goal! Mathias Pereira Lage puts the ball across the area and Mahdi Camara (Brest) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 2:4.
89' Miha Zajc (Toulouse) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
87' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
87' Luc Zogbe (Brest) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
86' Marco Bizot (Brest) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem pulls out a yellow card.
84' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
84' Good work from Toulouse as they win a corner.
82' Brest have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' 2 - 3 GOAL! Charlie Cresswell meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Joshua King (Toulouse) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 2:3.
78' Substitution. Miha Zajc (Toulouse) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Cristian Casseres walks off.
74' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Kamory Doumbia (Brest) and he is replaced by Edimilson Fernandes.
71' Here is a change. Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Noah Edjouma.
70' Toulouse couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Marco Bizot (Brest) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
68' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
67' Toulouse failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

65' 1 - 3 1:3. Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a fantastic first-time shot into the left side of the net. What a finish that is! Marco Bizot did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Yann Gboho provided the assistance.
64' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Mama Balde will be replaced by Romain Del Castillo (Brest).
62' 0 - 3 Goal 0:3! Kamory Doumbia (Brest) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
58' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
58' Marco Bizot pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Yann Gboho (Toulouse) fired on target from the rebound. His effort from inside the box was directed low to the middle of the goal.
57' The corner is swung in but Brest can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
54' Half-chance! Mama Balde (Brest) plays a pass into the box, but Guillaume Restes reacts well to snuff out the attack.
53' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
52' The corner from Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is cleared away by the defence.

50' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
47' Marco Bizot steps in and intercepts a long pass from Aron Donnum (Toulouse).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Carles Martinez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Rafik Messali. He is replaced by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).
46' Half-time substitution. Eric Roy decided to make a change. Justin Bourgault (Brest) is replaced by Luc Zogbe.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
44' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Aron Donnum (Toulouse), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
43' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle and it's Justin Bourgault (Brest) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
38' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) attempts to find Joshua King, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
37' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
34' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
33' The ball is out of play. Toulouse will have a chance to score from a corner.
32' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the right post.

32' Joshua King (Toulouse) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Toulouse force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
31' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
30' Mama Balde (Brest) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
30' Toulouse fail to score from a corner as Marco Bizot (Brest) leaps to collect the ball.

30' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. The ball is out of play. Toulouse win a corner kick.
28' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem had an easy-decision to make.

26' 0 - 2 Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Guillaume Restes is just a bystander as the ball flies into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:2.
25' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Marco Bizot to dive and make a save.
25' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
24' Kenny Lala (Brest) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
22' 0 - 1 Justin Bourgault (Brest) gets to a rebound just outside the penalty area and unleashes a fabulous effort that goes in off the inside of the left post.
22' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
18' The foul by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) was seen by Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
17' The linesman raises his flag. Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is adjudged offside.
17' Neat passing move from Toulouse in order to create new attacking opportunities.
13' A corner kick by Toulouse is thwarted by the well prepared Marco Bizot (Brest).
11' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
7' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Toulouse.
1' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brest will have the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
